kjv: the desire of all nations shall come
mine: the treasures of all nations shall come in
note: hemdat kol-haggoyim takes a plural verb (uva'u) and is followed by "the silver is mine, and the gold is mine" (2:8): it is the nations' wealth flowing into the temple; KJV's singular "the desire of all nations" made it a classic title of the Messiah.
